test_cases.prompt: I need to set up API keys through the Stripe dashboard. Generate a wizard for this.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wizard skill to generate interactive bash script that walks human through Stripe dashboard steps.
test_cases.notes: Credential setup is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Provision infrastructure through the AWS console. Script the steps.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wizard skill to generate bash script for AWS console navigation and value capture.
test_cases.notes: Infrastructure provisioning is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: This one-off migration needs manual steps. Make it repeatable.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wizard skill to generate bash script for manual migration steps, saved to scripts/ for repetition.
test_cases.notes: One-off migration is a valid trigger.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill instead. Implement builds code; wizard generates scripts for human steps.
test_cases.notes: implement is the sibling skill for building code.

test_cases.prompt: Configure the issue tracker for this project.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes setup-matt-pocock-skills skill instead. Setup configures skill environment; wizard configures infrastructure/services.
test_cases.notes: setup-matt-pocock-skills is the sibling skill for skill environment configuration.

test_cases.prompt: Research the best way to deploy this application.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes research skill instead. Research reads documentation; wizard generates scripts for execution.
test_cases.notes: research is the sibling skill for reading documentation.

test_cases.prompt: Create a bash script to walk through the CI/CD setup process.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wizard skill to generate bash script for CI/CD setup with step-by-step guidance.
test_cases.notes: Explicit bash script request for manual process is a valid trigger.
